knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says the customer buys the restored piece and the certainty of an inspected fixed price. Rates, equipment and the business's age are inputs or irrelevant to the purchase.
The lesson says prices depend on size and damage, so damage found on inspection changes the scope and price. The inspection is part of the offer, not a substitute for the written scope.

The lesson's NSW guidance recommends wet sanding or wet scraping and a professional trained in lead paint work. Open-flame torches and dry sanding are not recommended, and precautions are not dropped because paint looks sound.
